# Acadlytic, Inc.

> AI-powered EdTech CRM & Cloud Platform for Academic Management. Where Education Meets Intelligence.

Acadlytic connects admissions and CRM, student records, academic operations, finance and fees, communication, documents and analytics on one cloud platform, with AI features that keep people in control of consequential decisions.

- Website: https://acadlytic.com/
- Contact: info@acadlytic.com · +91 8010707171
- Request a demo: https://acadlytic.com/company/request-demo/
- Official profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/acadlytic, https://x.com/acadlytic, https://www.youtube.com/@acadlytic, https://www.instagram.com/acadlytic/, https://www.facebook.com/acadlytic/

## Platform

- [Academic Management](https://acadlytic.com/core/academic-management/): Cloud academic management software that unifies admissions, student records, academic operations, finance and reporting for colleges and universities.
- [EdTech CRM](https://acadlytic.com/core/edtech-crm/): An EdTech CRM designed for education: manage enquiries, applicants, students, parents, alumni and partners as lifelong relationships on one cloud platform.
- [Cloud Platform](https://acadlytic.com/core/cloud-platform/): Acadlytic runs as a cloud platform for academic management: browser-based access, managed updates, scalable infrastructure and security built into operations.
- [Pricing](https://acadlytic.com/core/pricing/): How Acadlytic pricing works: what shapes a quote for your institution, which modules are included and how to get a proposal tailored to your size and scope.
- [Platform](https://acadlytic.com/platform/): Explore the Acadlytic platform: admissions and CRM, student management, academic operations, finance, communication, analytics and documents on one cloud data model.
- [Admissions & CRM](https://acadlytic.com/platform/admissions-crm/): Admissions CRM for colleges and universities: capture enquiries from every channel, automate follow-ups, track applications and convert applicants to enrolments.
- [Student Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/student-management/): Student management software that keeps one accurate record per student: profile, programme, documents, attendance, results, fees and communication history in one place.
- [Student Lifecycle](https://acadlytic.com/platform/student-lifecycle/): Manage the full student lifecycle, from enquiry and admission to progression, completion and alumni, with defined stages, hand-offs and visibility across teams.
- [Application Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/application-management/): Track every application from start to decision: online forms, document checklists, review workflows, offers and acceptance, with full visibility for applicants and staff.
- [College Recommendations](https://acadlytic.com/platform/college-recommendations/): Help students and counsellors shortlist colleges and programmes that fit academic profile, interests, budget and location, with transparent matching criteria.
- [Post-Secondary Database](https://acadlytic.com/platform/post-secondary-school-database/): A structured database of colleges, universities and programmes that counsellors and students can search and compare by location, requirements, cost and study mode.
- [Academic Operations](https://acadlytic.com/platform/academic-operations/): Run academic operations in one system: academic calendars, timetables, attendance, assessments, results and course administration for colleges and universities.
- [Finance & Fees](https://acadlytic.com/platform/finance-fees/): Manage fee structures, invoices, instalments, concessions, online payments and reconciliation, connected to student records and communication.
- [Communication Hub](https://acadlytic.com/platform/communication-hub/): Message students, parents, applicants and staff by email, SMS and WhatsApp, with templates, consent management, scheduling and a full history on every record.
- [Document Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/electronic-document-sharing/): Collect, verify, store and share academic documents securely: application documents, certificates, transcripts and requests, with permissions and an audit trail.
- [Completion Tracking](https://acadlytic.com/platform/completion-tracking/): Track every student’s progress toward completion: credits, requirements, clearances and milestones, with early alerts when someone is off track to graduate.
- [Task Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/task-management/): Assign, track and complete institutional tasks with owners, due dates and context, generated by workflows or created by staff, across every department.
- [Analytics & AI](https://acadlytic.com/platform/reports-insights/): Real-time reports and dashboards for admissions, academics, finance and engagement, with scheduled delivery, drill-down and AI-generated summaries.
- [Data Management](https://acadlytic.com/platform/data-management/): Keep institutional data accurate and governed: validation rules, duplicate management, data dictionaries, imports, retention and access controls on one platform.
- [Workflow Automation](https://acadlytic.com/platform/workflow-automation/): Automate repetitive academic and administrative processes with a no-code workflow builder: triggers, conditions, approvals, tasks and notifications.
- [Institutional Dashboard](https://acadlytic.com/platform/institutional-dashboard/): An institution-wide dashboard for leadership: admissions, enrolment, academic health, finance and engagement indicators in one role-based view, updated from live data.
- [Student Engagement](https://acadlytic.com/platform/student-engagement/): Understand and improve student engagement with connected signals from attendance, participation, communication and services, plus timely, personalised outreach.
- [Enrolment Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/platform/enrollment-analytics/): Analyse your enrolment funnel from enquiry to enrolled: conversion by stage, source and programme, cycle-over-cycle comparisons and forecasts for planning.

## Acadlytic AI

- [AI Assistant](https://acadlytic.com/core/ai-assistant/): The Acadlytic AI Assistant answers questions about admissions, students and operations in plain language, drafts messages and explains reports, within user permissions.
- [Acadlytic AI](https://acadlytic.com/ai/): Acadlytic AI brings assistants, predictions, recommendations and document intelligence into academic workflows, with human approval and clear explanations.
- [AI for Admissions](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-for-admissions/): AI for admissions teams: prioritise follow-ups, draft personalised replies, summarise applicant histories and forecast intake, with counsellors in control.
- [AI for Student Success](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-for-student-success/): Identify students who may need support earlier with explainable early-warning signals from attendance, submissions and engagement, then coordinate timely outreach.
- [AI for Advising](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-for-advising/): AI tools for academic advisors: meeting briefs, progress summaries, suggested next steps and follow-up drafting, so advisors spend more time with students.
- [AI Recommendations](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-recommendations/): Next-best-action recommendations for admissions, advising and administration teams, based on institutional data and explained so staff can decide confidently.
- [AI Personalisation](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-personalization/): Personalise communication and portal experiences for applicants and students by programme, stage, language and preferences, with consent and transparency.
- [AI Insights](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-insights/): AI insights watch institutional data for unusual changes, such as sudden drops in enquiries or spikes in absences, and alert the right team with context.
- [AI Reporting](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-reporting/): AI reporting turns dashboards into plain-language summaries for leadership, explaining what changed, why it may matter and what the data cannot tell you.
- [AI Workflows](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-workflows/): Automate administrative work with AI steps inside approval-based workflows: classify, extract, draft and summarise, with confidence thresholds and a full audit log.
- [AI Search](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-search/): Find people, records, documents and answers across Acadlytic with natural-language search that understands intent and respects permissions.
- [Document Intelligence](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-document-intelligence/): AI document intelligence classifies uploaded documents, extracts key fields and checks legibility and completeness, so staff verify faster with fewer errors.
- [Predictive Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-predictive-analytics/): Forecast enrolment, demand and capacity with predictive analytics that show ranges, assumptions and accuracy, so planning is informed rather than overconfident.
- [AI Communications](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-communications/): Draft clear, on-brand messages for students, parents and applicants with AI, including translation, tone adjustment and summaries, always reviewed before sending.
- [AI in Education](https://acadlytic.com/ai/ai-in-education/): Where AI genuinely helps education institutions today (administration, student support and insight), where it does not, and how to adopt it responsibly.
- [Responsible AI](https://acadlytic.com/ai/responsible-ai/): The principles and controls that govern AI in Acadlytic: human oversight, transparency, privacy, fairness monitoring, security and institutional control.

- [Admissions Teams](https://acadlytic.com/solutions/for-admissions-teams/): For admissions teams: faster response to every enquiry, organised follow-ups, application tracking and clear conversion reporting, with AI that prepares the groundwork.
- [Advisors](https://acadlytic.com/solutions/for-advisors/): For academic advisors and counsellors: full student context, caseload views, early-warning signals, meeting notes and referrals, so every conversation counts.
- [Student Services](https://acadlytic.com/solutions/for-student-services/): For student services teams: case management, service requests, referrals, wellbeing support and communication, with full context and privacy controls.
- [Faculty](https://acadlytic.com/solutions/for-faculty/): For faculty: quick attendance, simple marks entry, class lists with context and alerts about students who may need support, so teaching comes first.
- [Students](https://acadlytic.com/solutions/for-students/): For students: one portal for applications, documents, timetables, attendance, results, fees and messages, available on mobile, with clear next steps.
- [Parents](https://acadlytic.com/solutions/for-parents/): Keep parents and guardians informed about attendance, results, fees and events through their preferred channel, within the student’s privacy settings.
- [Institutions](https://acadlytic.com/industries/): How Acadlytic adapts to universities, colleges, community colleges, private and public institutions, online and lifelong learning, and multi-campus groups.
- [Community Colleges](https://acadlytic.com/industries/community-colleges/): Acadlytic for community colleges: open-access enrolment, part-time and returning learners, workforce programmes and student support on one connected platform.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/): Connect Acadlytic with student information systems, LMS, ERP, payment gateways, single sign-on, email, WhatsApp and your own apps via APIs, webhooks and exports.
- [SIS Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/sis-integration/): Integrate Acadlytic with your student information system to sync student records, enrolments and results, avoid duplicate entry and keep one source of truth.
- [LMS Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/lms-integration/): Connect Acadlytic with your learning management system: provision courses and enrolments, bring back grades and activity, and use LMS signals for student support.
- [ERP Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/erp-integration/): Integrate Acadlytic with your ERP or accounting system for fee postings, general ledger summaries, HR and staff data, while keeping student-facing finance in Acadlytic.
- [CRM Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/crm-integration/): Connect Acadlytic with an existing enterprise CRM or marketing platform: sync contacts, campaigns and outcomes so recruitment and marketing share one picture.
- [SSO Integration](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/sso-integration/): Let staff and students sign in to Acadlytic with your institution’s identity provider via SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect, with centralised access and deprovisioning.
- [Payment Gateways](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/payment-integration/): Collect application and tuition fees online through payment gateways, with automatic invoice matching, instant receipts and daily settlement reconciliation.
- [Email](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/email-integration/): Connect Acadlytic with institutional email: send from your domain with proper authentication, log staff emails on records and keep deliverability healthy.
- [WhatsApp](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/whatsapp-integration/): Use WhatsApp Business messaging for admissions, reminders and parent updates, with approved templates, opt-in consent and conversations logged on each record.
- [SMS & Messaging](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/messaging-integration/): Send SMS and in-app notifications through connected providers for alerts and reminders, with sender registration, delivery reports and consent rules.
- [Calendar](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/calendar-integration/): Sync timetables, advising appointments, interviews and events between Acadlytic and staff and student calendars, with booking links and reminders.
- [REST API](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/api/): The Acadlytic REST API lets institutions and partners read and write platform data securely, with scoped credentials, rate limits, versioning and sandbox access.
- [Webhooks & Events](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/webhooks/): Subscribe to Acadlytic events such as application submitted, student enrolled or payment received, and trigger your own systems in near real time.
- [Data Export](https://acadlytic.com/integrations/data-export/): Export Acadlytic data on demand or on a schedule for analytics, archiving and portability, in open formats, with permissions and export logging.

## Optional

- [Glossary](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/): Plain-language definitions of academic technology terms: academic CRM, SIS, ERP, education analytics, student lifecycle, SSO, education cloud and more.
- [Academic CRM](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/academic-crm/): Academic CRM definition: software that manages an institution’s relationships with prospective students, applicants, students, parents and alumni across the lifecycle.
- [Admissions CRM](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/admissions-crm/): Admissions CRM definition: software that helps admissions teams capture enquiries, follow up, track applications and measure conversion to enrolment.
- [Student Information System](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-information-system/): Student information system definition: the system of record for student data such as enrolment, courses, grades, attendance and credentials at an institution.
- [Academic ERP](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/academic-erp/): Academic ERP definition: enterprise resource planning adapted for institutions, covering finance, HR, procurement and often student administration in one suite.
- [Student Lifecycle Management](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-lifecycle-management/): Student lifecycle management definition: coordinating every stage of a learner’s journey from enquiry and admission through study and completion to alumni.
- [Education Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/education-analytics/): Education analytics definition: collecting and analysing data about students, programmes and operations to inform decisions, from descriptive reports to predictions.
- [Learning Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/learning-analytics/): Learning analytics definition: measuring and analysing data about learners and their contexts to understand and improve learning and learning environments.
- [Institutional Analytics](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/institutional-analytics/): Institutional analytics definition: using operational, financial and student data to inform strategy, planning and performance management at institution level.
- [Academic Operations](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/academic-operations/): Academic operations definition: the day-to-day processes that run teaching and assessment, including calendars, timetables, attendance, exams and results.
- [Admissions Management](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/admissions-management/): Admissions management definition: the end-to-end process of recruiting, assessing and admitting students, from enquiry through application, decision and enrolment.
- [Student Success](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-success/): Student success definition: students achieving their educational goals, and the institutional practices, support and data used to help them get there.
- [Student Engagement](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/student-engagement/): Student engagement definition: the degree of involvement students show in their learning and institutional life, and how institutions observe and support it.
- [Workflow Automation](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/workflow-automation/): Workflow automation definition: using software to run repeatable institutional processes (triggers, rules, tasks, approvals and notifications) with minimal manual effort.
- [Education Cloud](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/education-cloud/): Education cloud definition: cloud-hosted software and infrastructure that institutions use to run academic and administrative systems as a managed service.
- [Education API](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/education-api/): Education API definition: an application programming interface that lets education systems exchange data securely, such as student, course or payment information.
- [Single Sign-On](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/single-sign-on/): Single sign-on definition: an authentication method that lets users access multiple systems with one set of institutional credentials, managed centrally.
- [Electronic Document Management](https://acadlytic.com/glossary/electronic-document-management/): Electronic document management definition: capturing, storing, organising, securing and sharing documents digitally with version control and access rules.
